caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, off-white background. The main object on the left is a detailed depiction of a metal spur with a brown leather strap. The spur is colored in varying shades of brown and metallic gray, with the leather strap having a reddish-brown appearance and attached to the spur using a silver-gray circular button. The buckle of the strap is gray as well. The metal spur features a curved neck leading to a rowel, which is a star-shaped rotating wheel colored in dark brown. The second object, located to the upper right of the main object, is a smaller, detached rowel mechanism, also shown in brown metal with a similar star-shaped wheel and a screw mechanism. The drawing is outlined with a rectangular border and includes handwritten texts reading "Actual Size" on the lower left and "Eldon Allen" on the lower right.
title: Spur
